title: Gifted
synopsis: One day, Amakusa Natsuki—the hope of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department—meets an unusual high schooler named Shiki Yuuya. Natsuki's interest in the high schooler is piqued after Yuuya happens to be passing through the scene of a difficult murder case and determines the perpetrator with ease. How did he know who the killer was? When an incident later takes place at Yuuya's high school, the two happen across each other again... Thus, a young policeman and a high schooler with a hidden power begin unraveling the mystery!

title: Chao Shen Jixieshi
synopsis: Han Xiao, a veteran player of the game "Galaxy" died unexpectedly in the middle of doing a leveling request. He was transmitted to the game world ten years earlier and became an NPC with a player's panel and was reborn in the base of the game's villain. In order to survive, Han Xiao resolutely chose the "Mechanic" occupation and concentrated on cultivation. Familiar with the iterations and rules of multiple versions of the game, he vowed to lead the army of machines, overthrow the villains, and rise from scratch to become the strongest. (Source: AC.QQ, translated)

title: Liaotian Qun De Richang Shenghuo
synopsis: On a certain day, Song Shuhang accidentally joined a deeply afflicted Xianxia chuunibyou(Year 2 middle school disease) chat group, the group members inside all address each other as ‘fellow daoist’. Their contact cards are all either Sect Master, Cave Master, Spiritual Master or Heavenly Expert. Even the group master’s missing pet dog named Great Devil Dog abandoned his home. They chat all day about things like concocting pills, intruding mysterious territories, martial arts experiences and more. One day, he abruptly realizes after lurking for a long time that…… In this group, every single group member is actually a real cultivator, with the ability to move mountains and drain seas, the kind that can live for thousands of years! Ah ah ah ah, his worldview has utterly collapsed in a single night!

title: Nian Fanchen
synopsis: Li Nianfan transmigrated into the world of immortal cultivation with a mortal body. After learning that he had no talent for cultivation, he settled down to live an ordinary life. But only to find... The dog he adopted watched his writing and painting, and became the demon lord that ruled half the world. The tree he planted in the backyard listened to him play and sing, and grew into the world tree that held up the bridge between heaven and earth. A casual conversation enlightened a passing traveler to become the immortal sage that defined the era... (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Chenmo Zhi Lan
synopsis: The story takes place in the City of Sin in a future galaxy: In order to adapt to the changes brought about by technology, a large number of galactic citizens have undergone a high degree of physical modification. However, a group of "cyborgs" has become weaponized, and a series of riots have occurred, plunging the galaxy into unprecedented turmoil. The culprit behind is a high-tech criminal organization codenamed "Illum". In order to fight this evil force, the "Tacit Blue" investigation team led by Carl was established. They began a life-and-death confrontation with Illum, and discovered the shocking conspiracy behind the cyborg riot... During this time, each member of Tacit Blue had to face their own past and scars, and learn to face and redeem themselves, all while saving the galaxy.

synopsis: After a difficult upbringing, Qingchen's life takes a drastic turn when a mysterious countdown emerges on his arm. He is taken to Prison No. 18, a dangerous parallel universe, when it reaches zero. He overcomes severe adversity and gains the respect of the demigod Li Shutong by using his cunning and bravery. He then becomes his disciple and embarks on a journey of genuine transformation.
